t: What Commercial Fishing Is All About
title: What Commercial Fishing Is All About
description: Commercial fishermen harvest wild seafood using boats, nets, traps, and lines under strict quota and season regulations. Deckhands work the gear; captains navigate, find fish, and run the business. Coastal fishing ports: New England lobster and scallops, Alaska crab and salmon, Gulf shrimp, Pacific trawl fleets. Work is seasonal, weather-driven, and physically demanding. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.
